results.title: Dolph Lundgren Discussed 'Legal Suicide' With Brother During Cancer Battle
results.description: In his new memoir, 'Fights Worth Fighting,' Dolph Lundgren writes about his difficult cancer battle and discussing 'legal suicide' with his brother.
